name: Beads Visualizer
description: Gateway-mounted /beads UI + API for browsing the Beads issue tracker as a DAG.
author: Tank (Eddie's stack)

repos.description: Configured Beads repos to expose. Each entry: { name, path }. The plugin shells out to `bd --cwd <path>`.

path.description: Absolute path to the repo containing .beads/

defaultRepo.description: Repo name to load by default in the UI (must match a repos[].name).
